description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Condition 7 (Landscaping) of planning permission ref. 55634/APP/2022/3372, dated 30-09-2024 (Demolition of existing building and construction of new mixed use development incorporating 2 no. retail units and 9 no. new dwellings.) -Demolition of existing building and construction of new mixed use development incorporating 2 no. retail units and 9 no. new dwellings.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The details submitted pursuant to Condition 7 fail to comply with the requirements of the condition and cannot be approved. The condition requires the submission and approval of landscaping details only; however, the application seeks to introduce details and alterations that extend beyond the scope of the condition and relate to matters requiring separate approval. Furthermore, elements of the submitted scheme are dependent upon, and directly relate to, details that have not been approved and are the subject of the refusal of application reference 55634/APP/2026/1849. In the absence of an approved scheme addressing those matters, the Local Planning Authority cannot be satisfied that the proposed landscaping can be satisfactorily implemented or maintained, nor that it would integrate appropriately with the overall development.
